name: Istio
description: Evidence and authorized read-only HTTP discovery guidance for istio.
automatic_actions: Record authentication boundaries and non-success statuses.
Prioritize these routes before broad wordlist enumeration.
Determine whether the endpoint belongs to a workload sidecar, ingress gateway, or mesh control plane.
follow_up: Identify proxy sidecars and ingress gateways; review mesh auth policies and exposed proxy admin routes.
Review proxy identity, mTLS, policy, admin-port exposure, and workload ownership.
stop_conditions: Stop or reduce request rate when throttling or instability is detected.
Do not perform mutations, authentication bypass, or destructive actions.
